_readme: Existing coastal defences for the map layer. Generated by tools/extract_sluice_candidates.py from the georeferenced CZMP scan. Only CANDIDATE sluice gates are extracted; bunds and seawalls are not.
source: CZMP Goa (NCSCM) map scan panjim_czmp.tif, WGS 84 / UTM 43N, 3.11 m/px (panjim-digital-twin/data)
method: Filled near-black near-square symbols (6–26 px side, fill ≥ 0.65, all channels < 110) inside the Panjim display box, on the Panjim side of the channel dividing line. Every detection is the same template (11–12 px ≈ 35 m), i.e. one symbol type. waterShare = share of the surrounding ~93 m drawn in water colours (reported, not filtered: some creeks are drawn in pink CRZ-II linework).
grounding_note: The CZMP legend (1.pdf) is not available in this project, so the symbol type cannot be confirmed: these are CANDIDATE sluice gates, inferred from symbol shape and position on creek channels inside khazan land. The case-study file notes that bund and sluice-gate symbols render near-black. Positions are good to roughly the symbol size (±20–40 m). Confirm against the legend and a field or survey check before relying on them.
prior1991Policy: Features marked 'prior to 1991' on the CZMP are treated as current existing infrastructure (case-study policy note, 2026-09-25).

notExtracted.reason: Line symbol; without the legend it cannot be told apart from roads, boundaries and creek-bank linework at this scan quality.
No reliably identifiable seawall symbol without the legend; not extracted.
